Buscar o preço atual de um par (por exemplo, BTC/USDT)
Get the latest trade price of one Binanc: Get the latest trade price of one Binance spot trading pair.
Get the latest trade prices of up to 100: Get the latest trade prices of up to 100 Binance spot trading pairs in one call.
Get 24-hour price change, high, low, vol: Get 24-hour price change, high, low, volume and best bid/ask for a Binance spot trading pair.
Get price change, high, low and volume f: Get price change, high, low and volume for a Binance spot trading pair over the last 1 minute to 7 days.
Get Binance's current average price of a: Get Binance's current average price of a spot trading pair over its short averaging window (5 minutes).
Get the current best bids and asks (orde: Get the current best bids and asks (order book depth) of a Binance spot trading pair.
Get the most recent trades of a Binance: Get the most recent trades of a Binance spot trading pair.

List the Binance pairs open for spot tra: List the Binance pairs open for spot trading right now (status TRADING and spot trading allowed), optionally filtered by base or quote asset.

The trading pair: base asset followed by: The trading pair: base asset followed by quote asset, for example BTCUSDT or ETHBTC. Spaces and '/' are removed and letters are upper-cased, so 'btc/usdt' also works. Use List Trading Pairs to find a symbol.
Trading pairs to price, for example BTCU: Trading pairs to price, for example BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT (base asset followed by quote asset). Up to 100. Spaces and '/' are removed, letters are upper-cased and duplicates are dropped. A comma-separated list in one item also works.
Full (default) adds price change and per: Full (default) adds price change and percent, weighted average price, previous close, last quantity and best bid/ask. Mini returns only open, high, low and last price, volumes and trade count.
How far back the window reaches: a numbe: How far back the window reaches: a number and a unit, 1m to 59m (minutes), 1h to 23h (hours) or 1d to 7d (days), for example 15m, 4h or 7d. Units cannot be combined. Defaults to 1h.
Price levels to return on each side, 1 t: Price levels to return on each side, 1 to 5000. Defaults to 20. Binance rate-limit weight: 5 up to 100 levels, 25 up to 500, 50 up to 1000, 250 above that.
How many of the most recent trades to re: How many of the most recent trades to return, 1 to 1000. Defaults to 50.
Length of each candle. 1m is one minute: Length of each candle. 1m is one minute and 1M is one month.
Optional. Return candles that open at or: Optional. Return candles that open at or after this time (UTC), for example 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z. Leave empty to get the most recent candles.
Optional. Return candles that open at or before this time (UTC). Must not be earlier than the start time.
Optional. Offset from UTC used to align: Optional. Offset from UTC used to align daily and longer candles, such as 8, -5 or 05:45 (from -12:00 to +14:00). Start and end times are always read as UTC. Defaults to UTC.
How many candles to return, 1 to 1000. D: How many candles to return, 1 to 1000. Defaults to 100.
Optional. Only pairs priced in this asse: Optional. Only pairs priced in this asset, for example USDT, BTC or EUR. Not case-sensitive.
Optional. Only pairs that trade this ass: Optional. Only pairs that trade this asset, for example BTC or ETH. Not case-sensitive.
Most pairs to return, 1 to 1500. Default: Most pairs to return, 1 to 1500. Defaults to 100. The output also says how many pairs matched in total.
